text:
DOSL7::enable
Description
Enables blocking and detection of DoS attacks according to the ASM
security policy configuration. DOSL7 will remain enabled on the
current TCP connection until it is closed or
DOSL7::disable
is called. When disabled
using
DOSL7::disable
, transactions will
bypass DoS L7 for both detection and prevention.
Syntax
DOSL7
::
enable
[
<
dos-profile-name
>
]
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
DOSL7
::
enable
}
